note: NECO Chemistry round 4 (Round 26 top-up): separating funnel for immiscibles, crude-oil fractions by boiling point, chromatography, crystallisation; Brownian motion, Boyle-law 200 to 100 cubic cm, melting; lead at cathode, oxygen at anode of dilute H2SO4, copper refining anode, brine chlorine by concentration; CaCO3 moles 0.1 and molar mass 100; precipitation vs titration routes, basic salt, all-soluble acids (HNO3 and CH3COOH); Mn +7 in KMnO4, zinc reducing agent, hydrogen loss as oxidation; surface area, catalyst paths, steep rate curves, Haber pressure; radius down-group, outer electrons, hydrogen bonding, malleability; esterification, polymerisation, C4H10 isomers, fermentation; water-treatment order, acid-rain gases, CO as blast-furnace reducer, aluminium by electrolysis, pop-test hydrogen, ammonia litmus. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-3, WAEC Chemistry (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
